videos.script: Before anyone builds the story, three people sit down. Joana for the business. Rafael for the code. Lia for what could go wrong. {{amigos}} Twenty minutes, and a table of cards. A yellow card for the story. Blue for each rule. Green for each example. Red for each question nobody can answer yet. {{map}} The green cards become a table of examples. Fifty-nine, sixty, sixty-one. A student on a Wednesday. A child at a Wednesday matinée. {{outline}} They run before the code is written, and three of them fail. That is the starting point. {{red}} Rafael works until all six pass. Then the story is done, and Joana knows it without reading the code. {{green}} And the red card is still on the table. A session typed as nine thirty. The agreed examples cover what was agreed. The rest is still the tester's. {{end}}
